description: This file defines a middleware function 'requireTenant' for Express.js that enforces tenant identification in requests. It extracts tenant information from JWT tokens, headers, query parameters, or fallback demo settings, and attaches it to the request object. It also sets response headers with tenant info and filters. The function responds with 400 or 403 on errors or mismatches.

methods.name: requireTenant
methods.description: Middleware function that enforces tenant identification from various sources and attaches tenant info to the request object.
